column1: # Seed examples only. Step 1 (prompts/02-gap-inventory.md) appends one row per real site. Do not treat these four as the survey.

column3: C function returns *const c_char; null means no update yet
column5: Copy to an owned String before the next receive. Do not store the raw pointer. Optional Mithka patch symbols stay Option<fn> and are never called.

column3: Flutter shows a chat photo only after a local file exists; otherwise initials
column5: Option<String> local path. None paints Avatar initials. A null updateChatPhoto clears the path.

column3: Per-user app data directory, Linux XDG
column5: $XDG_DATA_HOME/ad.neko.mithka.gpui/local-pins.json, or ~/.local/share/... when XDG_DATA_HOME is unset. Keyed by the canonical --database path. Same pattern for local-groups.json. subscriptions.json is the same directory and is not database-keyed.

column3: TDLib client thread versus UI thread
column5: The receive loop owns the TdJson client on a background thread. GPUI owns the main thread and only applies UiUpdate snapshots. The UI does not call td_receive.
